method.counter_method: slope between N and N/2 operations
method.note: Instruction count is the decision metric. Clock varied between about 2.17 and 4.50 GHz, so wall time and IPC are reported only as diagnostic observations. Response fusion was ablated in an isolated source copy with the same compiled extensions; the working tree was never rewound.

direct_native_application_entry.definition: the private server calls Wreath._wreath_http and receives the selected dispatcher awaitable directly
direct_native_application_entry.implementation: make _wreath_http an ordinary def that compiles if dirty and returns _dispatch_http(...) without creating and awaiting an otherwise empty coroutine

startup_prepared_orm_query.definition: one scripted ORM fetch on the Record hydration path, comparing a dynamic Select construction with a declared Queries plan compiled at startup
startup_prepared_orm_query.implementation: the existing Queries declaration surface already caches the compiled SQL, result plan and bind program; the new wreath-decomp arm makes that production path visible instead of adding a duplicate API

native_bearer_activation.definition: eight realistic request headers; exact built-in BearerTokenBackend with a synchronous verifier
native_bearer_activation.implementation: scan the native lazy header block and invoke the verifier in one C entry; await only its activation result; trust the compiled capability resolver instead of repeating role and permission loops in Python; subclasses and route-scoped custom backends retain authenticate(request)

native_typed_json_response.definition: one int path parameter and a handler returning a primitive dict under dict[str, Any]
native_typed_json_response.implementation: run_validation_json checks a dict[str, Any] response and writes its compact JSON bytes in one native traversal; an internal encoded carrier preserves the route's declared status through coercion; encoder TypeError falls back to the existing UUID, Decimal, bytes and set conversion definition
